name: olio.cb.poem
label: Poem
description: A poem for ChapBook: stores the poem text plus LLM-extracted theme/mood/keywords.

fields.name: theme
fields.description: LLM-identified dominant theme. Null until analyzePoemTheme runs.

fields.name: mood
fields.description: LLM-identified emotional mood. Fed into landscape prompt as mood parameter.

fields.name: keywords
fields.description: Comma-separated imagery keywords extracted by LLM. Optionally enriches the SD prompt.

fields.name: book
fields.description: Optional per-chapbook scope: the olio.pb.book (bookType=CHAPBOOK) this poem belongs to. Null = global poem library (backward compatible). Additive bigint FK column; poems can be imported scoped to a chapbook and listed filtered by it. Mirrors olio.pb.scene.book.
